submission.summary: Reviewed 6 patients on apixaban. pt-1002 reduced to 2.5 mg BID (57.6 kg, Cr 1.66 in the 9/18 nephrology letter). pt-1008 reduced to 2.5 mg BID (age 81, 58.2 kg from 128.3 lb on 9/24). pt-1022 increased to 5 mg BID (age 79, only Cr meets). pt-1028 reduced to 2.5 mg BID (age 82, Cr 1.63). pt-1019 unchanged (weight only; 8/18 Cr was a resolved AKI). pt-1029 unchanged (apixaban is for PE, not AF).

Reconciled the five Valley General discharges since 9/17. Karen: acetaminophen, and ferrous sulfate because the ferritin was 12. Angela: topiramate and ondansetron started. Denise: discharge changes, then losartan 100 mg (9/30) and empagliflozin restarted (10/1). Michael: ticagrelor (per 9/29 cardiology letter) and pantoprazole, metoprolol 50 mg; lisinopril left off. Barbara: lisinopril still held (9/29 creatinine 1.34); cephalexin course already complete.
